stem: Which key idea about the inhabitants of Venice in the 1920s is supported by the details in paragraph 11?

options.label: A
options.text: They lacked knowledge of the newest technology.

options.label: B
options.text: They depended on nearby cities for basic necessities.

options.label: C
options.text: They did not understand why parts of the city began to flood.

options.label: D
options.text: They needed to adapt to their environment.
